title: Alberino measures the Tombs of the Giants

tellings.quote: I went to Sardinia with a tape measure and yes, you can fit the bodies of giants in those tombs.

plain: The Tombs of the Giants, ancient stone tombs on the Italian island of Sardinia, are big enough to hold the bodies of giants, according to Tim Alberino, a researcher of giant legends. He tells Michels he went there himself "with a tape measure," and that "yes, you can fit the bodies of giants in those tombs," which he offers as support for the idea that very tall people were once buried there.
